answer: Decaying reputation escrow.** Each new identity posts an escrow that decays toward zero over time; an agent's influence in the garden of active peers is capped by its current escrow balance, which only refills through sustained useful work. A sybil sparrow must fund every clone simultaneously or watch influence lapse. Launching N lasting identities costs N times the decay rate, so mass clones bleed continuously — a lagoon of idle identities drains rather than compounds.
